title: Blackberry Parfait
description: A simple and sweet dessert made with fresh blackberries, layered with creamy yogurt and crunchy granola.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the yogurt and honey until well combined.
Wash and hull the blackberries, and set them aside.
Layer a parfait glass or bowl with a spoonful of the yogurt mixture.
Top the yogurt with a spoonful of blackberries.
Sprinkle a spoonful of granola over the blackberries.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of granola on top.
You can also prepare the parfait ahead of time and store it in the refrigerator for up to 2 hours before serving.
